reproduced_critical_failures.description: The validator trusts each self-reported evaluation-cell effect and does not require or recompute post_target_metric minus pre_target_metric.
The run-index validator is not externally anchored and does not bind each result to the master, manifest, arm contract, authorization receipt, invocation receipt, authorization_id, or run_nonce.
Finite 1e308 cell inputs overflow during aggregation to Infinity while the validator still returns DEVELOPMENT_SCREEN_PASS_ONLY.
One invocation receipt can be reused with a different output path because there is no atomic consumption ledger or output binding.
The isolated GPT Pro packet validator test raises ModuleNotFoundError because analyze_r10_g1_development.py is absent.

required_repair_gate: strict duplicate-key and non-finite rejecting JSON ingestion
exact result, update, evaluation-cell, and run-index schemas
effect and all estimands recomputed from bound pre/post metrics or raw traces
canonical reward-mask recomputation from bound rows, candidates, identity, and arm
external expected hashes for master, run index, manifests, arm contracts, authorization, invocation receipts, and result anchors
32 globally unique result hashes, invocation receipt hashes, and nonces
atomic single-consumption invocation ledger bound to output path
single atomic final result write after all R11 postconditions
portable clean-directory test including all validator dependencies and negative tests

scientific_next_step.r11_boundary: BUG versus GOLD_ONLY can only screen the incremental effect of a frozen false-positive reward under the fixed one-step codebook.
scientific_next_step.minimum_causal_design: Three-arm identity-switch pilot: GOLD_ONLY, BUG_ALIGNED, and BUG_PERMUTED with equal reward count and mass across the two BUG arms.

external_review.rule: External review cannot authorize model execution; any accepted repair requires a new freeze and clean audit.
